BiblicalUsage: En-Chatsor is a place in Palestine. The name appears in Joshua (Joshua 19:37). It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Chatsor matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Chatsor is one of them.
